career_ladder.note: Multipurpose Health Workers (MPHW - Female/Male) are recruited under the Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Odisha, to deliver primary healthcare, maternal and child healthcare, and national disease control programmes across Sub-Centres and Community Health Centres. Promotion avenues follow the Odisha Subordinate Health Services Rules.

exam_scheme.note: The OSSSC Multipurpose Health Worker examination comprises a single-stage Written Examination (OMR / CBRE) assessing technical paramedical/nursing coursework along with basic arithmetic and English, followed by Document Verification.

stages.stage_name: Stage I: Written Examination (Technical Coursework & General Subjects)
stages.source_label: OSSSC Multipurpose Health Worker Scheme of Examination (Advt No. IIE-51/2023-882(C)/OSSSC)

papers.paper_name: Written Test (Technical Diploma/ANM Syllabus 60 Q / 60 marks, Practical Skills 25 Q / 25 marks, Class 10 Arithmetic 10 Q / 10 marks, Class 10 English 5 Q / 5 marks)
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1/4th penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks: 35% for SC/ST/PwD/Sports/ESM, 40% for General and SEBC candidates

stages.stage_name: Stage II: Document Verification & Registration Validation
stages.source_label: OSSSC Document Verification Protocol for Healthcare Cadres

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of ANM/Diploma Certificates, Valid Registration in Odisha Nursing and Midwives Council / Pharmacy Council, and Odia Standard
papers.qualifying_threshold: Mandatory valid council registration and verification of all original eligibility credentials

financial_package.note: Multipurpose Health Workers in Odisha are appointed under Pay Matrix Level 5 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 (Pay Scale ₹21,700 - ₹69,100 with entry basic pay of ₹21,700). Health workers serving in rural sub-centres and scheduled tribal areas receive additional rural healthcare allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, Finance Department, Government of Odisha
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on entry basic pay of ₹21,700 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹12,586) + House Rent Allowance (9% for rural Sub-Centre/CHC headquarters, up to 18% in municipal health units: ₹1,953 to ₹3,906) + Medical Allowance (₹500) + rural health duty and uniform allowance (~₹1,000). Statutory deductions include 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹3,429), Professional Tax (₹200), and GIS (~₹250).
official_perks: Sub-Centre residential quarter accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA at 9% to 18% as sanctioned)
Special tribal/rural healthcare service allowance for difficult geographic postings
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement under Odisha Government Servants' Medical Attendance Rules
Dearness Allowance (DA) linked to state government cost-of-living index revisions
Contributory pension scheme under New Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% government contribution
Maternity leave, child care leave, and statutory leave entitlements under Odisha Service Code
